cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W, hashlib

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

# 1. same-datagram retirement affects later envelope routing (I/H coalesced)
# I packet: RETIRE seq0 (dcid aa=seq0? no - retiring dest is PV; use packet addressed to bb retiring aa? seq0 is dest of aa packets)
# Packet 1 addressed to bb (seq1) retires seq 0. Packet 2 addressed to aa -> DROP_CID
p1 = envelope('I', 0, bytes([0x19]) + W.v(0), width=1, cid=b'\xbb')
p2 = envelope('I', 1, b'\x01', width=1, cid=b'\xaa')
tr = trace([datagram(p1+p2, auth=[0,0])])
check("same-datagram-retire", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'packets.1.status':'DROP_CID', 'retired_local':[[0,1]]})

# 2. auth indexing: attempt j uses auth[j]; bad header consumes slot
bad = bytes([0xc4])
good = envelope('I', 0, b'\x01')
tr = trace([datagram(bad, auth=[0]), datagram(good, auth=[0])])
check("auth-index-1", tr, {'packets.0.status':'BAD_HEADER', 'packets.1.status':'OK'})
tr = trace([datagram(good+good, auth=[0])])  # second attempt has no auth -> AUTH
# note: two I envelopes coalesced; second uses auth[1] absent -> AUTH
g = check("auth-index-2", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'packets.1.status':'AUTH'})

# 3. I/H only annotation0: auth=[null, 5] -> AUTH
tr = trace([datagram(good, auth=[None, 5])])
check("auth-ann0", tr, {'packets.0.status':'AUTH'})
tr = trace([datagram(good, auth=[5])])
check("auth-ann0-ok", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK'})

# 4. A seed: DUPLICATE of seed; epoch0 min/max
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 3, b'\x01'), auth=[0])], received={'I':None,'H':None,'A':3})
check("a-seed-dup", tr, {'packets.0.status':'DUPLICATE', 'packets.0.epoch':0, 'received.A':3,
                         'epochs':[{'epoch':0,'min':3,'max':3,'count':1}]})
# epoch0 extends below seed: pn 1 accepted at epoch0 -> min 1
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x01'), auth=[0])], received={'I':None,'H':None,'A':3})
check("a-seed-extend", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'epochs':[{'epoch':0,'min':1,'max':3,'count':2}]})

# 5. frame error rolls back epoch advancement
evs = [dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x99', width=1), auth=[1])]
tr = trace(evs)
check("epoch-rollback", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'packets.0.epoch':1,
                             'key_epoch':0, 'epochs':[]})

# 6. key events after close ignored
evs = [dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x1c'+W.v(0)+W.v(0)+W.v(0), width=1), auth=[0]),
       dict(keys=['I'])]
tr = trace(evs)
check("keys-after-close", tr, {'keys':['A'], 'closed.code':'PEER_CLOSE'})

# 7. NO_KEY when key removed
evs = [dict(keys=[]), datagram(envelope('I', 0, b'\x01'))]
tr = trace(evs)
check("nokey", tr, {'packets.0.status':'NO_KEY', 'received.I':None})

# 8. epoch display on DUPLICATE and on frame error (annotation), null on DROP_CID/PN_RANGE
evs = [dict(keys=['A']),
       datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[0]),
       datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[2]),
       datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x99', width=1, phase=1), auth=[1]),
       ]
tr = trace(evs)
g = check("epoch-display", tr, {'packets.1.status':'DUPLICATE', 'packets.1.epoch':2,
                                'packets.2.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'packets.2.epoch':1})
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, cid=b'\xff'), auth=[0])])
check("epoch-display-dropcid", tr, {'packets.0.status':'DROP_CID', 'packets.0.epoch':None})

# 9. retired_local interval merging
r0 = bytes([0x19]) + W.v(0)
r1 = bytes([0x19]) + W.v(1)
r3 = bytes([0x19]) + W.v(3)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']),
           datagram(envelope('A', 0, r0+r1+r3, width=1, cid=b'\xbb'), auth=[0])])
check("retired-merge", tr, {'retired_local':[[0,2],[3,4]]})

# 10. FIN then RESET same final OK; different final -> FINAL_SIZE_ERROR
fin = stream(0, 0, b'abc', fin=True)
rst = bytes([0x04]) + W.v(0) + W.v(5) + W.v(3)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, fin+rst, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("fin-then-reset", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'streams.0.final':3, 'streams.0.reset':5})
rst2 = bytes([0x04]) + W.v(0) + W.v(5) + W.v(4)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, fin+rst2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("fin-then-reset-bad", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FINAL_SIZE_ERROR'})

# 11. RESET huge final -> FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR
rst3 = bytes([0x04]) + W.v(0) + W.v(5) + W.v(2**20)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, rst3, width=1), auth=[0])], stream_credit=10)
check("reset-flow", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR'})

# 12. STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED references/opens but no state
sdb = bytes([0x15]) + W.v(4) + W.v(9)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, sdb, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("sdb", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'opened.bidi':2, 'streams.0.high':0, 'used':0,
                  'streams.0.id':4})

# 13. hidden catch: DATAGRAM frames ignored; ACK trailing in A
dg = bytes([0x31]) + W.v(2) + b'zz'
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, dg+b'\x01', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("datagram-frame", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'streams':[]})
